# react-colorful

The application imports react-colorful 5.8.1 through its pinned pnpm lockfile.
Vite bundles the picker locally; there are no CDN or runtime network requests.

Upstream: https://github.com/omgovich/react-colorful

MIT license and upstream acknowledgments are included alongside this file.
The InfoPatri wrapper is `src/editors/common/ColorPicker.tsx`.
Indexed colors come from `officialPalette` in `src/domain/chartThemes.ts`,
derived exclusively from `src/domain/patriColors.ts`, plus the personal library.
